title: New York, day one
summary: Five people, one drum and a very small car. Elif's diary from the trip.

items.example: Elif writes in her diary every night.
There was a lot of traffic.
The apartment is on the fifth floor.
The view from the window is amazing.

sections.title: Read and listen
sections.heading: Tuesday, December 22nd
sections.intro: Elif's diary, written at midnight in Rafael's kitchen.
paragraphs: We left Boston at eight this morning. Jake's car is small, and there were five of us, three guitars and the new drum.
It was too small for all of us, of course. I sat next to the drum for four hours.
There was a lot of traffic near the city, so we arrived at two instead of twelve. Lucas slept for most of the trip. How?
Rafael's apartment is on the fifth floor, and there's no elevator. We carried the drum up the stairs. It was heavier than Lucas!
The apartment isn't big enough for five people, but the view from the kitchen window is amazing: roofs, water towers and a little piece of the river.
In the evening, we walked in the city. The streets were very crowded, and everything was bright and loud.
I drew a small bookstore on the corner. I'm going to go inside tomorrow morning.
Tomorrow night, the band is playing its first concert here. I'm going to sell T-shirts at the door.
Now I'm going to sleep. On the sofa. With the drum.

items.statement: The car was big enough for everyone.
They arrived later than they planned.
There's an elevator in Rafael's building.
Elif likes the view from the kitchen.
The band's first concert was on Tuesday.
